original_assumption: outdoor ground vehicle, planar offset, global GNSS and NDT factors
direct_transfer_test: same x/y/yaw grid and temperature on fixed indoor inputs; separately equal-budget 6D extension
anticipated_mismatch_not_result: attitude modes missed; expensive Cartesian product; no GNSS for recovery
adapted_method: covariance-gated coarse-to-fine and Hessian subspace with fixed-grid coverage anchors
evidence_and_acceptance: R2 ≥90% recall and ≤2 pp deficit vs best simple equal-budget grid; runtime and pose-axis coverage

original_assumption: weak directions are identified locally in point-to-plane registration
direct_transfer_test: measure alignment of weak eigenvectors with separated NDT peaks and candidate recall
anticipated_mismatch_not_result: weak direction need not point toward rival mode; scaling changes axes
adapted_method: whiten pose coordinates and use weak directions as optional proposals; retain anchors
evidence_and_acceptance: R2 correlation of direction and recall; R6 weak-axis and refine drift check

original_assumption: different occupancy corresponds to spatial change under matching coverage
direct_transfer_test: two-way new voxels on the same fixed candidate views
anticipated_mismatch_not_result: occlusion and sampling can mimic occupancy difference
adapted_method: common visibility and verified free versus occupied states
evidence_and_acceptance: R3 false alarms and comparable area with matched bounds

original_assumption: co-registered dense static clouds and stable local normals
direct_transfer_test: normal-cylinder projection with unchanged support model
anticipated_mismatch_not_result: local normals and projection may be sparse or poorly conditioned
adapted_method: controlled sensor visibility and effective support regularization

original_assumption: modelled measurement and inter-epoch registration uncertainty
direct_transfer_test: original propagation when sensor calibration permits and safe equivalence proxy otherwise
anticipated_mismatch_not_result: same-map candidate covariance and lateral alignment invalidate independence model
adapted_method: propagate pose changes and shared errors or conservative bounds
evidence_and_acceptance: R3 paired perturbation test; empirical interval coverage and cost

direct_transfer_test: compute distance on a frozen set of regularized voxel pairs
anticipated_mismatch_not_result: grid density and covariance shrinkage can dominate actual geometry
adapted_method: common visible support and fixed eigenvalue regularization
evidence_and_acceptance: R3 density/perturbation stratification; separate R4 ranking utility

original_assumption: recognizable contour boundaries approximately orthogonal to weak axis
direct_transfer_test: apply cross-section landmark pipeline where the geometry qualifies
anticipated_mismatch_not_result: regular corridor may lack certified cross-section or reverse correspondences
adapted_method: use projected partial surfaces and independent temporal support
evidence_and_acceptance: R3 cross-frame support ≥70%; expose coverage and false positives

original_assumption: single-pose joint grid or detector repeatability under geometric changes
direct_transfer_test: independent original SPS/USIP baseline with compatible weights or record unavailable
anticipated_mismatch_not_result: domain transfer and repeatability do not imply pose discrimination
adapted_method: use delayed stable support as a veto and fixed map-difference mask
evidence_and_acceptance: R3 stability independent of candidate correctness; R4 G5 vs G6

original_assumption: local stable features and temporal association in lidar odometry
direct_transfer_test: apply published feature stability and compare fixed point budget
anticipated_mismatch_not_result: single-state selection can preserve stable but non-discriminative geometry
adapted_method: occupancy/normal difference plus shared region-wise observation reliability
evidence_and_acceptance: R3 repeatability and R4 equal-budget paired ranking

original_assumption: native Gaussian sum optimized under a single local objective
direct_transfer_test: full cloud vs fixed full deletion vs information or random sampling
anticipated_mismatch_not_result: selection distorts negative evidence and weakens constraints
adapted_method: frozen common subset and soft weights; bounded full-geometry refinement
evidence_and_acceptance: R4 ≥10 pp ranking gain; R5 verified pose recovery; R6 geometry preserved

original_assumption: measurement covariance computed for original observations and directions
direct_transfer_test: record original covariance offline as control; no unchanged covariance injected into second fit
anticipated_mismatch_not_result: correlated evidence and mode selection can make covariance overconfident
adapted_method: reestimate local and between-mode uncertainty; accept one stamped observation
evidence_and_acceptance: R7 consistency, risk/coverage and harmful admission; R8 causal integration
